title: Publishing Briefs: Leader Entertainment and Sony Music Publishing Form Strategic Partnership
summary: Plus, MusicInfra has partnered with Amazon Music, Lee Thomas Miller has signed to WCM Nashville and Perfect Game Creative, and more publishing news and signings.
contentText:
Leader Entertainment, the parent company of children’s entertainment brand El Reino Infantil, entered into a new partnership with Sony Music Publishing, announced Oct. 5, which will administer the brand’s complete music catalog worldwide. “This alliance will allow us to strengthen our shared capabilities, drive the creation of new content, and innovate across formats that generate new opportunities to continue expanding our most iconic intellectual properties internationally,” said Michel Pumar , chief strategy officer of Leader Entertainment, in a statement.

Oscar Galvan , managing director, South Cone, Sony Music Publishing, added, “Powered by our expert teams across Argentina and Mexico, we look forward to expanding the reach of this truly iconic catalog as it continues to inspire millions of children and families around the world.”

See more publishing news and signings below.

MusicInfra Partners With Amazon Music for Music Video Rights Management

MusicINfra is partnering with Amazon Music to support rights management on the streaming service and ensure music publishers are paid correctly and on time.

“MusicInfra will provide the critical features, speed and flexibility to support Amazon Music as we expand our music video offering,” James Duffett-Smith , director of business affairs and global head of music publishing at Amazon Music. “We look forward to a productive relationship with MusicInfra and with publishers as we move forward.”

Björn Lindvall , co-founder and CEO of MusicInfra, added, “MusicInfra was built to deal with the speed and scale Amazon Music needs to be able to offer something new to music lovers. We are eager to support Amazon Music and enhance its music service and expands opportunities for rightsholders and customers.”  — Ariel King
